disputed_verses.BHSA NEH 10:14: רָאשֵׁ֖י הָעָ֑ם פַּרְעֹשׁ֙ פַּחַ֣ת מֹואָ֔ב עֵילָ֥ם זַתּ֖וּא בָּנִֽי׃
disputed_verses.KJV NEH 10:14: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

first_reader_said: NEH 10:14: Elam among the 'chiefs of the people' is the house of Elam (Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu... follow Ezra 2), and A already records him as named on the sealed document at 10:14, so B duplicates him.

why: B contains only the Elam entry in NEH 10:14, which A already explicitly records, and supplies no distinguishing family ties or other occurrences. A preserves the fuller family associations in EZR 2:7, 8:7, 10:2, 10:26 and NEH 7:12. NEH 12:42 supplies no parentage connecting or distinguishing its Elam, so that occurrence remains uncertain, but it does not establish B as a separate person.
